concerns.text: Task T003 simulates a complete study dataset instead of collecting real participant data, thereby weakening FR‑001 (participant recruitment), FR‑002/FR‑003 (real SART/Ospan/PSS‑10/PANAS measurements), and FR‑004 (real compliance logs). This also violates Constitution Principle VII (Intervention Fidelity) which requires genuine participant data.
There is no task that implements the web‑based recruitment interface or the delivery of SART/Ospan/PSS‑10/PANAS to real participants, leaving FR‑001, FR‑002, FR‑003, and FR‑004 uncovered.

Success criteria SC‑001 – SC‑004 (e.g., Holm‑Bonferroni‑corrected p < 0.05 and Cohen’s d ≥ 0.2) are never verified by any task or test; no acceptance‑criterion check exists, making these criteria effectively untestable.
